answer: What survives to the delta is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The jade is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the tundra. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
